title: TypedAction
description: The only shape of instruction the server may return, and the only shape of instruction the companion may execute. Phase 5: action enum limited to click/noop as a contract-shape proof — the full action set (scroll, navigate, input, etc.) arrives alongside real reasoning in Phase 8.

target_id.description: References an element id from the SanitizedContext this action was decided from. Null for noop.

value.description: Reserved for future action types (e.g. input text). Unused by click/noop.
